snippet.title: SCP:Project Pneuma
snippet.description:
THE WAIT IS ALMOST OVER.

SCP's are coming this October.

SCP: PROJECT PNEUMA
A psychological survival horror experience where nothing is as it seems.
The anomalies are waking.
The Foundation is losing control.
And your survival is no longer guaranteed.

OCTOBER 2026.
Coming to PC
 
Watch closely.
This is only the beginning.
ARE YOU READY TO ENTER?

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3872430/SCP_Project_Pneuma/
